articles.title: Crown Series - New Competitive Mode
articles.summary: Duels are back? Duels are a Clash Royale game mode that was introduced to the game back in 2020, with the Clan Wars 2 update. Since then, the mode has remained fairly niche outside of the competitive CRL scene.
